jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Python
jobs.content: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer.</p></div><p>Requirements:</p><ul><li>5+ years of experience with Python and Django or FastAPI</li><li>Experience designing REST APIs and PostgreSQL databases</li><li>Docker and Kubernetes deployment</li><li>100% remote position</li></ul>

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Hybrid)
jobs.content: <p>Cloudflare is hiring a Software Engineer. We work in a hybrid model with 3 days in the office. Proficient in Python, Redis, and Linux.</p>
